notes: Map-first building: the AI draws a top-down map layout and waits for your Approve before placing anything. Model workspace exports GLB, OBJ, STL and PLY with Blender, Unity, Godot, Unreal, web and print scales, plus a blockout-to-export pipeline. 7 more UI themes (comic, steampunk, western, candy, vaporwave, mono, paper) and custom styles; UI no longer defaults to studs. Multi-agent helpers, model and VFX recipes, 16 new animation presets. Lower token cost per request.
